title: Radiators and Aftermath
author: Rosalind Vasquez
blurb: Theo Winterbourne, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
